body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one ally within 5 units. It gains +1 Defense against the next Action from a creature you can see before your next turn. You may make that ally Possessed.

surges.html: If this Rite triggers because of an ally, that ally becomes Rallied.
Increase this Rite's Echo Limit by 1; when its final Echo resolves, one ally in range becomes Rallied.

rider.title: DIVINATION RITE
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Rite. Trigger: An enemy within 5 units becomes Exposed or uses a Reaction. Echo: Reveal whether it has any remaining Reactions or maintained effects; one ally gains +1 die against it.
